options: The specific, formal address tied to a legal entity's registration
A hierarchical structure of countries and states
A shipping address for a warehouse
Any address used anywhere in Oracle Fusion
questions.explain: A legal address is the formal address a legal entity is registered against, managed through Manage Legal Address.

options: It stores the company's chart of accounts segments
It provides the hierarchical country/state/city/postal code structure that validates and standardizes addresses
It defines a business unit's assigned ledger
It tracks currency conversion rates
questions.explain: Geography data validates and standardizes every address entered against a given country, through its hierarchy of country, state, city, and postal code.

questions.q: What happens if a country's geography structure in Oracle Fusion is incomplete or wrong?
options: The chart of accounts for that country is disabled
Nothing; geography data has no effect on addresses
Every address entered against that country can inherit validation errors or fail to map to the correct tax jurisdiction
The legal entity for that country is automatically deleted
questions.explain: Incomplete or incorrect geography data causes downstream problems for every address entered against that country, including tax jurisdiction mapping issues.

questions.q: What is a 'location,' as distinct from a legal address?
options: A type of chart of accounts segment
A conversion rate type
It is identical to a legal address in every way
A general-purpose, reusable address record used for offices, shipping points, or HR work sites, not necessarily tied to legal registration
questions.explain: A location is a broader-purpose address record that can be reused across many contexts, and does not require any tie to legal entity registration.

questions.q: Why is reusing the same location record across multiple contexts (an office, a shipping point, a legal address) considered a good practice?
options: It is required by Oracle Fusion and cannot be avoided
It keeps address data consistent and avoids having several slightly different versions of the same address scattered across the system
It automatically creates a new legal entity
It removes the need for geography data entirely
questions.explain: Reusing one location record avoids data-quality problems caused by re-entering the same address slightly differently in multiple places.
